description.p: Shalom! We are happy to welcome Hebrew translations, fully contributed by Menachem (naattxx). Toda raba!
description.translatorHint: Release notes for version 0.7.0 - Hebrew translation. Keep the greeting 'Shalom!', the thanks 'Toda raba!' and the name 'Menachem (naattxx)' as they are.

description.p: Hebrew is also our first right-to-left language: thanks to Menachem's testing and contributions, the app now supports right-to-left layouts, preparing it for more RTL languages.
description.translatorHint: Release notes for version 0.7.0 - right-to-left (RTL) support

description.p: Selamat datang! We also welcome Indonesian translations, kindly contributed by Arif Budiman. Terima kasih!
description.translatorHint: Release notes for version 0.7.0 - Indonesian translation. Keep the greeting 'Selamat datang!', the thanks 'Terima kasih!' and the name 'Arif Budiman' as they are.

description.p: As always, this release includes many small fixes and improvements.

description.p: Fixed an issue where the back button in the learn section was always visible in desktop and tablet mode, even when no subpage was open.
description.translatorHint: Release notes for version 0.6.5 - back button fix

description.p: Under the hood: updated to TypeScript 6, Vite 8, and other dependency upgrades for improved performance and stability.
description.translatorHint: Release notes for version 0.6.5 - dependency updates

description.p: Shared code examples now include CC-BY-4.0 license information, making it clear how the community can use and build upon your contributions.

description.p: We've added a new Examples section to the Learn tab where you can explore and run fully-commented 6502 programs right in the app. Start with our featured Snake game example and see how those pixels come to life!
description.translatorHint: Release notes for version 0.6.0 - new examples section

description.p: Got your own cool 6502 creation? Share it with the community! You can now submit your code examples directly from within the app. Just hit the share button, and we'll automatically create a GitHub issue and pull request for you.
description.translatorHint: Release notes for version 0.6.0 - community contribution feature

description.p: Learning by example has never been easier. Dive into working code, tweak it, break it, fix it again - that's how the best programmers learned back in the day!
description.translatorHint: Release notes for version 0.6.0 - learning from examples

description.p: Say hello to many fresh translations: French, Interlingua, Portuguese, Portuguese (Brazil), Dutch, Spanish, Ukrainian, Japanese and Chinese (Simplified)
description.translatorHint: Release notes for version 0.5.0 - language selector and new translations

description.p: German and Spanish have been validated by contributors. Other languages are AI‑assisted drafts and need human validation.
description.translatorHint: Note about validation status - keep it concise and encouraging

description.p: If you speak one of the listed languages, please help review or improve the translations. You can contribute via the in‑app links, our translation platform, or by opening an issue.
description.translatorHint: Call to action for community translation/validation

description.p: This release brings vibrant handheld-inspired theming with customisable colours. We've introduced adaptive tablet and desktop layouts that keep everything in view, perfect for those marathon coding sessions when learning to develop retro games in assembly. Big thanks to our new contributor @mmartinortiz for the great desktop layout ideas. There are some cool technical improvements too, like TypeScript strictness, custom GtkSourceView style schemes, and enhanced debugger controls for smoother development.
description.translatorHint: Release notes for version 0.4.0
